themes.summary: WSJ reported US will resume attacks on Iran after Nov. 3 midterms with more carriers and troops; Brent rose $4.28/b to $102.31/b.
Middle East exports reached nearly 13 million b/d over Sept. 1-28, up from 10.7 million b/d in August, and Goldman put Gulf flows at 2025 levels, though Iranian exports remain shut in.

themes.theme: Persistent Gulf disruption and tight stocks
themes.summary: Dallas Fed executives mostly expect normal Gulf exports no earlier than Q2 2027 and Goldman cited record low stocks and escalation risk.

themes.theme: Diesel tightness and US export ban
themes.summary: A US diesel export ban would cut US refinery runs by nearly 2 million b/d per CERA and the ULSD crack fell to $102.09/b on ban or SPR-release pricing.

themes.theme: Asian demand for Atlantic Basin crude
themes.summary: Japan's US crude imports rose to 844,685 b/d in August and WTI Midland premium to Dubai was $31/b on Sept. 30 after a record $34.60/b.

themes.theme: Rhine low water and European logistics
themes.summary: Rhine at Kaub fell to record low 6 cm below benchmark, cutting Shell Godorf and Karlsruhe loadings by a third.
Brazil output hit a record 4.615 million b/d in August and Kazakhstan seeks to lift BTC flows to 7 million mt/year.
